texto: Hi,how you doing?how is life there on other part of the world?I would like to hear from you.
frase_cierre: Write without a name. Someone, far away, will read it.

respuesta.texto: Life here is slow this week: warm afternoons, mate with friends and long walks after work. How is it there?
respuesta.encabezado: This is how someone from Argentina might reply
respuesta.pie: The bottle set sail from South Africa.
